escenas.dice: Nineteen eighty-nine, Greyhorn Mountain. Elsa Brandvold, fifty-four, walks into a snowstorm.
It's the night of the Winter Carnival gala at her own ski lodge. She never comes back.
Next morning, they find her at the bottom of Hollow Gully, nine meters below the footbridge to her chalet.
The sheriff calls it an accident. An icy bridge, house slippers, one glass of wine too many.
Thirty-seven years later, the mountain gives back three things. A roll of film nobody ever developed.
Her green notebook, melting out of the snow.
And her strongbox. Nobody has ever opened it.
Five people at the lodge had a reason to want her gone.

January 28, 1989. Elsa Brandvold, 54, owner of Greyhorn Lodge, walks out into a snowstorm on the night of the Winter Carnival gala. Next morning she is found at the bottom of Hollow Gully, 9 meters below the footbridge to her chalet. The sheriff rules it an accident. Thirty-seven years later, the mountain gives back an undeveloped roll of film, her green notebook and a strongbox nobody can open.

The case is fiction: it's Cold Case File No. 02, The Snow Remembers, a printable murder mystery game. You get the whole file (38 evidence documents plus a sealed envelope) and work out who did it, how and why. 1-6 players, about 2-3 hours, no host. English and Spanish versions included.
